events: At frame 0 set lane 1 Rate 8, Phase 0, Shape Pulse, Hits 5, Trigger On, Depth 1, model 21, pitch 36, voice level 0.2, master 0.65, and Run On.
At non-quantum sample offsets change Phase, Rotate, Chance, and a signed Pitch route through channel-16 CC messages.
At a later non-block offset enter Global, raise Cohere, issue one Clear edge, return to lane 1, and render through all block partitions.
conditions.purpose: Drive the frozen direct Core and the VST processor with equivalent Controls transitions and compare exact stereo samples and accepted traces.

events: Serialize a dense seven-lane program with signed routes, cohesion, Run, seed, page 6, and Motion mode.
Restore the bytes into a fresh instance and a fresh direct-Core fixture without replaying Clear.
Render both from frame zero, then inject one Clear and verify exactly one effect-clear transition.
conditions.purpose: Prove transactional complete program recall and the declared fresh volatile-state equivalence relation.

events: Prepare two independent instances with identical state and render identical blocks.
Mutate only instance A through one parameter, private mode, and Clear event.
Verify instance B parameter bytes, accepted snapshot, diagnostics, and subsequent PCM remain equal to its untouched comparator.
conditions.purpose: Detect shared globals, controller state, Core state, scratch buffers, accepted mailboxes, or editor-history leakage.

events: Instantiate at 44100 Hz and 96000 Hz, process nonempty MIDI and output buffers, and require exact silence.
Attempt malformed, wrong-version, duplicate-ID, missing-ID, non-finite, and truncated state payloads.
Request unsupported audio layouts and verify fail-closed behavior without changing the last valid program.
conditions.purpose: Prove deterministic silence and transactional retention at unsupported host and state boundaries.

events: Scan the built bundle through a separate JUCE VST3 host and require exactly one Pamplist instrument description.
Instantiate at 48000 Hz and 512 frames, require zero input and stereo output, create and destroy an unattached editor, set the enabled single-lane fixture, and render nonzero finite PCM.
Round-trip state into a second module instance and compare the fresh render and parameter inventory.
conditions.purpose: Validate the actual arm64 VST3 ABI bundle rather than only the directly linked processor class.

timeline_convention: Frame zero is the first output sample after prepare or accepted state recall. A MIDI event at host sample position N applies before rendering sample N; equal-position events retain JUCE MidiBuffer iteration order. Calls over 512 frames are consecutive source-time partitions with no inserted or dropped frame.
